purpose: Define the minimum kernel-level interface and missing-core declaration that the current operator-v1 module must expose before an accepted fixed CI/correlated implementation can exist.

required_checks.requirement: The target module exposes the kernel-contract entrypoint.
The reported selected operator class matches the current fixed-CI/correlated implementation lane.
The kernel contract explicitly reports that accepted implementation is still missing.
The missing core components are enumerated rather than left implicit.
The runtime exporter remains diagnostic-only while the kernel status is missing.

claim_boundary: This manifest makes the missing kernel explicit. It does not implement or validate a fixed CI/correlated or UET correction operator.
